A BITTER RADISH PROJECT

The Royal Court

An interactive take on real tennis: a game of angles, timing and wonderfully unusual buildings.

The game

Walls, sloping penthouse roofs, the angled tambour and winning openings make the building part of every rally. This evolving singles simulation brings together serves, volleys, chases, changing ends and tennis scoring.

Find your way onto court

Start with the interactive controls lesson, rally in either practice mode, play a match, or enter the eight-player tournament. In a tournament you play your own matches; the other results in that round are revealed after your match, using player ratings. The tournament assigns a different court to each of its seven matches. The bracket and court assignments save on your device. Reloading during a match restarts that match, while completed results stay saved.

Make it yours

Choose a player from the club roster, a court and a match format. Stamina, movement, power, accuracy, consistency and intelligence affect play. Lower-intelligence opponents can misread the tambour. Choose High, Low or Overview under Controls & view.

Our courts range from parquet and timber clubs to Camden-inspired brickwork, Palestra-inspired architecture and animated Sphere walls. Sphere changes its moving motif between games.

The controls

  • Move the mouse to move your player.
  • Scroll toward you for a backswing; scroll away to hit.
  • Left-click selects a drive; right-click selects a lob.
  • On touch screens, drag on court to move and use the racket pad to swing.
  • Use power calibration in Settings for your own scroll speed.

Still on the practice court

This is a work in progress, with simplified rules and procedural player movement. Court behavior and uncommon rule situations continue to be refined.
